D1.rationale: The COMPLETION §2 provides an AC-by-AC result table covering all 10 stated ACs (AC-A through AC-J), each marked SATISFIED with re-runnable commands or concrete checks; §3 also records the execution sequence and Layer 1 completion.

D2.rationale: The bundle contains no sections labeled REVIEW:, ACCEPTANCE-TEST:, or TRACE EVENTS. Although COMPLETION §§4-5 reference two Blake review files and describe their asserted verdicts, the actual review artifacts are not included in the bundle; per the D2 Evidence Scope Rule, the handoff's review references and completion narrative do not count as executor verification artifacts.

D3.rationale: The completion report documents a disciplined process: §3 gives a ten-step implementation and verification sequence, §2 records evidence for every AC, and §5 distinguishes Layer 1 self-check, code review, security review, re-review after a P1 fix, and the final Gate 3 verdict.

D4.rationale: COMPLETION §6 records eight concrete friction items with status, evidence, and disposition; §7 records seven execution-time decisions, including the security-review-driven overwrite/--out fix. This makes deviations, substitutes, and risk handling explicit rather than implicit.

D5.rationale: COMPLETION §8 includes an explicit Knowledge Assessment, identifies one reusable discovery, names the destination file `.tad/project-knowledge/patterns/research-methodology.md`, gives the exact entry title, and explains why it is durable project knowledge rather than an implementation detail.
